mentions.name: BackerBase
mentions.description: BackerBase is a state- and local-level campaign finance tracker that brings campaign finance data, public filings, donor networks, races, officials, and entity relationships into one source-backed workspace. It starts with Louisiana and is adding more states.
mentions.problem: Since followthemoney.org was absorbed by Open Secrets in 2024, there has been no state-level "follow the money" tool for local and state campaign finance.
mentions.source_excerpt:
